examples.english: “she cried out and wept, she and all the disciples together, and said: Woe unto sinners, for their chastisements are exceedingly numerous!” Mary came forward, she fell down at the feet of Jesus, kissed them and said: “My Lord, bear with me if I question thee, and be not wroth with me, that I trouble thee oft; for from now on I will begin to question thee on all things with determination.”
